description: This file defines FastAPI API routes related to job management, asset uploads, analysis triggering, result retrieval, and artifact download for a branding compliance backend service. It includes data models, route handlers, and integrations with services like AnalyzerService, FixerService, and StateStore.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new job request.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for response containing a new job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for job status response.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for fixing a single asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for batch fixing assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler for creating a new job, initializing its state.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler for deleting a job and its workspace.

methods.name: None _save_upload_to(path: Path, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Internal helper to save an UploadFile to a Path.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler for uploading a zip of assets and extracting.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler for uploading old brand reference image.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handler for uploading new brand reference image.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Trigger background analysis and generate previews.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieve current job status and progress.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Get list of assets and issues for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Return a preview file of an asset in various views.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Apply automatic fix to a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Run automatic fixes on all assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Download job report or zipped outputs.
